melbourne-victoria-mornington-peninsula-.story: A proper escape from Melbourne with roads worth waking up for. A 641 km loop that starts and ends near Mount Martha, about 11 h 39 of riding. It goes by way of Scenic stretch near Bacchus Marsh, near Trentham and Melbourne / Victoria. Sorrento is the high point. The line favours views over speed.

melbourne-victoria-mornington-peninsula-.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Bacchus Marsh → Photo stop near Trentham is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

This Photo stop near Trentham → Melbourne / Victoria return stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Melbourne / Victoria return → Food stop near Alexandra can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Food stop near Alexandra → Altona is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 70 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-baie-de-gresine-le-grand-lac-de-c.story: From Aix-les-Bains it runs 290 km to Aix-les-Bains; allow about 5 h of riding. The stops in between: Immeuble Clarté, Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux and back through Immeuble Clarté. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
